stem: Periodontitis is found in a school-age child. Which approach to the diagnostic work-up is most consistent with AAPD guidance?

options.text: Attribute the findings to local plaque factors alone, because systemic disease does not affect the periodontium in children.
Include systemic medical conditions in the differential diagnosis, using the AAPD list of conditions that affect periodontal health.
Rule out medication effects, because drugs do not influence periodontal tissues.
Defer any consideration of systemic causes until the child reaches adolescence.
